🚨 Wednesday was the busiest single day for Channel crossings in all of 2026 — 781 people arrived on the Kent coast.

The government's line? Crossings are down 42% on last year, so it's 'progress'. 📉

What they didn't lead with: the Home Secretary ordered an urgent review the same day, after two boats evaded detection completely in 48 hours. She called it 'not acceptable'. 🚤

A falling yearly average doesn't mean much on the day 781 people get through and two boats aren't even spotted.

Real control means removals that work and boats that don't get through — not picking the most flattering number available.
